text: dsh-prometheus-plugin 是一个供 DSH agent 使用的 Prometheus 工具插件：它通过 Cordis 注册一组 promql- 工具，并连接配置的 Prometheus HTTP API。用户可以执行即时或区间 PromQL 查询、查看指标与标签元数据、检查抓取目标和告警规则，并读取服务状态；另含搜索与 TSDB 管理接口。适合需要在 DSH 对话中查询和了解 Prometheus 监控数据的用户。需要一个可通过 HTTP 访问的 Prometheus 实例，默认地址为本机 127.0.0.1:9090；不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-prometheus-plugin connects DSH tools to a configured Prometheus HTTP API. Agents can run instant and range PromQL queries, inspect metrics, targets, alerts, and server status. It requires an HTTP-reachable Prometheus instance, defaulting to http://127.0.0.1:9090; no API key is configured.
我想让 DSH 帮我跑 PromQL 即时查询和时间范围查询。
怎么从对话里查看 Prometheus 的指标标签、抓取目标和告警规则？
Can my DSH agent query Prometheus metrics over a time range?
dsh-prometheus-plugin 的功能「PromQL 查询」：使用 promql-query 或 promql-query-range 执行即时或区间表达式，并返回 Prometheus 响应。
dsh-prometheus-plugin 的功能「监控状态查看」：调用状态、目标和规则工具，读取 Prometheus 运行信息、抓取目标与告警规则。
dsh-prometheus-plugin 会把 PromQL 请求发送到配置的 Prometheus HTTP endpoint；默认地址为本机 127.0.0.1:9090，可更改配置。

@local/dsh-prometheus-plugin README · dsh-prometheus-plugin：A [DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin that exposes the
Prometheus HTTP API as a set of tools an LLM agent can call. Built on the
[Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) framework and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`.

@local/dsh-prometheus-plugin README · Features：- **30 tools** covering the full Prometheus HTTP API: instant / range queries,
  metadata & series discovery, targets, rules / alerts / alertmanagers, server
  status, the experimental Search API, and the admin TSDB endpoints.
- A single shared HTTP client (`src/client.ts`) with consistent error formatting
  and a configurable request timeout (`AbortController`, default 30s).
- Declarative tool definitions via `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, friendly for agent use.

@local/dsh-prometheus-plugin README · Prerequisites：- A running Prometheus instance reachable over HTTP.
- Some endpoints require extra Prometheus launch flags:
  - **Admin tools** (`admin-snapshot`, `admin-delete-series`, `admin-clean-tombstones`)
    require `--web.enable-admin-api`.
  - **Search tools** (`search-metric-names`, `search-label-names`, `search-label-values`)
    require `--enable-feature=search-api`.
  - Some endpoints are only available in newer Prometheus versions
    (`format-query`, `parse-query`, `query-exemplars`, `status-tsdb` (3.6.0+),
    `status-self-metrics`, `features`, …). Pointing a tool at an older server
    returns an HTTP error from Prometheus itself.

@local/dsh-prometheus-plugin README · plugin_manager install_bundle /path/to/dsh-prometheus-plugin：```

The bundle declares `cordis.patch.yml`, which registers the `promql-plugin`
entry with the package `@local/dsh-prometheus-plugin` (resolved via the
`dsh.bundle.patch` field in `package.json`). No manual `cordis.yml` editing isyaml
- insert:
    - id: promql-plugin
      name: '@local/dsh-prometheus-plugin'
      config:
        prometheusEndpoint: http://127.0.0.1:9090
```

@local/dsh-prometheus-plugin README · plugin_manager install_bundle /path/to/dsh-prometheus-plugin：Edit the patch (or override the entry's config) to point at your Prometheus
instance. `prometheusEndpoint` defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:9090` when omitted.
bash
npm install        # postinstall runs tsc, output to lib/
```

> Note: runtime dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`,
> `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`) are declared as peer dependencies matching the
> DSH host runtime; they are not bundled into the plugin.
@local/dsh-prometheus-plugin README · Tools：All tools are registered with the `promql-` prefix.
